title: CWP/19859/2025 of NAVPREET HOSPITALITY LLP Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text:
CWP No. 19859 of 2025 (O&M) 1 -D IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH CWP No. 19859 of 2025 (O&M) Date of Decision:22.07.2025 Navpreet Hospitality LLP ceseee Petitioner Versus State of Haryana and others sesees Respondents CORAM:- HON'BLE MRS.JUSTICE LISA GILL HON’BLE MRS. JUSTICE MEENAKSHI I. MEHTA Present: Mr. Anand Chhibar, Sr. Advocate with Mr. Shikhar Sarin, Advocate Mr. Inderjeet Singh, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Sourabh Goel, Addl.AG., Haryana. Mr. Amit Jhanji Sr. Advocate with Mr. Anhad Batta, Advocate Mr. Rahul Bhargav, Advocate for respondent No.5. sek LISA GILL, J.

1. Grievance raised in this writ petition is that authorities have granted L1 and L13 licenses, Annexure P-8 to respondent No.5 in violation of Clauses 4.4 (a), 4.6 (a), 5.2(a), 5.8(a) of the Haryana Excise Policy 20252027.

2. Learned counsel for respondent-State submits that it is only provisional licenses which have been issued as of now and final approval by the Collector shall be afforded only after considering representations dated 07.07.2025 and 13.07.2025, Annexures P-10 and P-11 respectively, submitted by petitioner. Therefore, present writ petition, is stated to be preSANJAY KHAN mature. Punjab and Haryana High Court, Chandigarh CWP No. 19859 of 2025 (O&M) 2

3. Learned counsel for respondent-State, on instructions, from Mr. Ajit Sihag, DETC, Hissar Excise 2025, submits that final decision shall be taken and speaking order shall be passed within three weeks. Learned counsel for the petitioner in the given factual matrix does not deny that at this stage matter is indeed pre-mature. He however submits that matter be decided finally by the Collector after affording due opportunity of hearing. No objection in this regard is raised by learned counsel for respondents. Let opportunity of hearing be given by Collector to all affected persons before taking a final decision, which be by way of a speaking order.

4. Writ petition is disposed of accordingly. Pending application(s), if any, stand(s) disposed of accordingly. (LISA GILL ) JUDGE (MEENAKSH I. MEHTA) July 22, 2025 JUDGE s.khan Punjab and Haryana High Court, Chandigarh
